shared.positions: geocentric apparent (light-time, aberration, nutation), true equinox of date

jyotisha.houses: whole-sign from sidereal Lagna (Parashari primary track)
jyotisha.node: mean node primary; true node reported as alternative
jyotisha.aspects: graha drishti: all 7th; Mars +4th,+8th; Jupiter +5th,+9th; Saturn +3rd,+10th; nodes excluded
jyotisha.dignity: exaltation/debilitation sign, moolatrikona ranges, own sign, else compound (panchadha) relationship with sign lord (BPHS natural + temporal)
jyotisha.functional_nature: rule set FN-1: trikona lords (1,5,9) benefic; lords of 3,6,11 malefic unless also trikona lord; natural benefic owning kendra only -> neutral (kendradhipati); 8th lord malefic unless also Lagna lord; 2nd/12th lords take nature of their other house; Moon/Sun owning only 2 or 12 -> neutral; lord of both kendra and trikona -> yogakaraka
jyotisha.divisional: D9 navamsa: floor(lon/(10/3)) mod 12; D10 dasamsa: odd sign counts from itself, even sign from 9th

western.sect: day if apparent altitude of Sun centre > 0 at birthplace
western.aspects: Ptolemaic by whole sign; degree orb reported; 'close' if within 3 deg; applying/separating from relative speed
western.lots: Fortune day=Asc+Moon-Sun, night=Asc+Sun-Moon; Spirit is the reverse
western.profection: annual, age 0 = 1st house, Gregorian birthday to birthday
western.solar_return: exact return of natal tropical Sun longitude; computed for birthplace and current residence

bazi.calendar: sexagenary; year from Li Chun (Sun 315 deg); month from sectional terms (jie)
bazi.primary_time: local civil time (IST); local apparent solar time retained as alternative track
bazi.day_boundary: local midnight (00:00); late-Zi (23:00-24:00) handled as same-day under sect 2 rule; not applicable here
bazi.da_yun_direction: yang-year male / yin-year female forward, otherwise backward
bazi.da_yun_start: interval to adjacent jie (UTC, astronomical) x (365.2425/3) days; periods of 10 Gregorian years
useful_god_schools: Tiao-Hou (seasonal regulation, Qiong Tong Bao Jian table)

tibetan.losar_rule:
Element-animal year only. Losar boundary is handled by a lower bound, not a lineage calendar:
    Tibetan Losar (Phugpa and Tsurphu) begins a lunar month and falls on, about one day from, or one
    lunar month after Chinese New Year; it is never earlier than the day before Chinese New Year.
